title: Schema artifact index
description: The root index.json carried by a schemas.tar.gz release artifact. Version 1, matching schema_index: 1.

schema_index.description: Contract version. The publisher accepts only 1.

project.description: Project name. Must equal the locked artifact's project and forms the first URL segment.

release.description: SemVer release. Must equal the locked artifact's version.

path.description: Path to the schema file within the archive. The basename becomes the published filename, so basenames must be unique across the index.

compat.description: Compatibility line this release belongs to: the SemVer major, or 0.MINOR before 1.0. Must agree with release.

dialect.description: JSON Schema dialect. Must equal the $schema declared inside the file.
